basic_details.job_title: NIHE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Field Assistant, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE), Garhwal Regional Centre, Srinagar (Garhwal), has invited applications from Indian citizens for four purely project-based temporary positions under NMHS-funded, DBT-funded and in-house projects: three Field Assistant posts (Rs.20,000, Rs.16,000 and Rs. 18000 fixed per month) and one Project Assistant post (Rs 18,000 plus HRA per month). Graduates can apply on the online recruitment portal (https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php) on or before 11:59 PM on 11 December 2026.

NMHS funded project (Carbon Budget and Eco-hydrological dynamics of selected Himalayan High-altitude Grasslands and their Carrying Capacity); NMHS funded project (Ecohydrology and Vulnerability Assessment in Groundwater-fed and Snow and Glacial-fed River Systems of Western and Eastern Himalaya under the Warming Climate); DBT funded project (Promotion of high value medicinal plants cultivation, post-harvest management and value-addition in the Indian Himalayan Region); In-house project-03 (Fostering Socio-Ecological Security and Sustainable Bio economy in the Indian Himalayan Region through Community-Driven Block chain Governance Models)

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE) has its address at Kosi-Katarmal, Almora, Uttarakhand. This notice is issued for its Garhwal Regional Centre at Srinagar (Garhwal). The posts are project-based and sit under four projects, two funded by NMHS, one by DBT and one in-house project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists four positions, one vacancy each, so the total is 4. It prints no category-wise break-up.

Field Assistant (NMHS project: Ecohydrology and Vulnerability Assessment)
Project Assistant (DBT project: high value medicinal plants)
Field Assistant (In-house project-03: Block chain Governance Models)
rows.pay: Rs. 18000/- fixed per month (8% increment after 2 years)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. The age limit printed for every post is 35 years; the notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. The notice says minimum requirements of qualification and/or experience can be relaxed for exceptionally outstanding candidates. Working experience in high-altitude grassland, specific to identification of plants. Experience in survey, documentation and analysis of datasets of plant communities. Good communication and writing skills. The notice prints no desirable qualification for this post. Preference will be given to candidates having experience in field-based work related to medicinal plants conservation and cultivation. Skills in nursery development, plantation techniques, and post-harvest handling of medicinal plants. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the challenging terrains of the Himalayas and conducting fieldwork and data collection in village/rural/urban areas of Uttarakhand. Willingness to stay and travel in the difficult terrains of the Himalaya is essential. Good photography/video creation and documentation skills. The notice states that the experience will not be considered without an experience certificate. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Environmental Sciences/ Biological Sciences/ Forestry/ Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System or other relevant subjects, from a recognized university
At least a graduate in any discipline from a recognized university
Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university
Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Field Assistant (0501) gets Rs.20,000/- fixed per month, Field Assistant (0502) gets Rs.16,000/- fixed per month, and Field Assistant (0504) gets Rs. 18000/- fixed per month with an 8% increment after 2 years. Project Assistant (0503) gets Rs 18,000 plus HRA per month. The notice describes all four as purely project-based temporary positions and says the engagement is purely temporary in nature. The length of the engagement is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: NIHE Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Survey and assessment of plant diversity, distribution, and utilisation in high-altitude grassland. Assessment of carrying capacity and ecosystem services emanating from high-altitude grassland. Data collection, data entry, and analysis. Assistance in field surveys, lab work in the project. Monitoring and maintenance of ex-situ conservation site of the institute. Any other scientific/technical jobs that may be assigned by PI/Co-PI from time to time. Assist Co-PIs and research fellows in field sampling and data collection, maintenance of data, data collection, and organize field trainings.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIHE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online recruitment portal of the Institute at https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php . Submit the application through the portal only on or before 11:59 PM on 11 December 2026. Mention in the application all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum prescribed qualification, supported with documents. Wait for the Institute to inform short-listed candidates separately about the mode of interview, date and time. Original documents of educational qualifications and experience, with one set of photocopies, for candidates appearing for a physical interview. Experience certificate, without which experience will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says short-listed candidates will be informed separately about the mode of interview, date and time. Mere fulfilment of the minimum advertised qualification and experience does not automatically entitle an applicant to be called for an interview or test. If many applications are received, the Institute reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility level to limit the number of candidates called, in line with the number of vacancies. The Institute's decision on this is final.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions, to fill or not to fill any or all posts, or to shortlist and select candidates in any suitable position depending on qualification and experience. Selected candidates are expected to join immediately. The selected candidate is liable to be posted anywhere in India. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. The Institute reserves the right to disengage the manpower at any time without assigning any reasons. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification. The Institute's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and conduct of examination/interview is final, and no query or correspondence will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies at the Garhwal Regional Centre: three Field Assistant posts (0501, 0502, 0504) and one Project Assistant post (0503), one vacancy each.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIHE Garhwal Regional Centre posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 December 2026. Applications must be submitted through the online recruitment portal on or before 11:59 PM that day.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIHE Field Assistant and Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Field Assistant (0501) needs a Bachelor's degree in Environmental Sciences/ Biological Sciences/ Forestry/ Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System or other relevant subjects. Posts 0502, 0503 and 0504 need a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years for all four posts, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIHE Field Assistant?
faq.answer: Field Assistant pay is Rs.20,000/- fixed per month for 0501, Rs.16,000/- fixed per month for 0502, and Rs. 18000/- fixed per month for 0504, with an 8% increment after 2 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the NIHE Project Assistant salary?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Project Assistant post (0503) the pay is printed as Rs 18,000 plus HRA per month. The Field Assistant posts are printed as fixed pay.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply through the online recruitment portal at https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php by 11:59 PM on 11 December 2026. State all qualifications and experience in the application, supported with documents.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Short-listed candidates will be informed separately about the mode of interview, date and time. Meeting the minimum qualification does not guarantee a call for interview or test.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NIHE job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes the posts as purely project-based temporary positions, and the engagement as purely temporary in nature.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the NIHE interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
